Article 20

(1) The Regional Government is obliged and responsible to implement efforts to prevent violence against Women and Children as referred to in Article 17 paragraph (3) letter e and paragraph (4) letter i carried out in the form of:
a. collecting data and organizing an information system for the Protection of Women and Children victims of violence;
b. conducting education on anti-violence values against Women and Children; and c. conducting socialization of laws and regulations related to the empowerment of Women and Protection of Children victims of violence.
2. The Regional Government is obliged and responsible to provide and organize services for victims in the form of: a. establishing and organizing technical service institutions for victims by involving community elements; and b. encouraging public awareness of the importance of protection for victims of violence.

CHAPTER I

GENERAL PROVISIONS

Article 1

In this Regional Regulation what is meant by:
1. Region is Palangka Raya City.

2. Regional Government is the Mayor as an element of the Regional Government administration who leads the implementation of government affairs that are the authority of the autonomous region.
3. Mayor is the Mayor of Palangka Raya.
4. Regional Apparatus hereinafter abbreviated as PD is an auxiliary element of the Mayor and the Regional House of Representatives in the administration of government affairs that are the authority of the Region.
5. Protection of women is all efforts aimed at protecting women and providing a sense of security in the fulfillment of their rights by providing consistent and systematic attention aimed at achieving gender equality.
6. Child protection is all activities to guarantee and protect Children and their rights so that they can live, grow, develop, and participate optimally in accordance with human dignity and dignity, and receive protection from violence and discrimination.
7. Violence is any act that results in misery or suffering physically, psychologically, sexually and/or neglect, including threats to commit acts, coercion, or deprivation of liberty by law.
8. Woman is a person who is female.
9. Child is a person who is not yet 18 (eighteen) years old who is not married, including a child who is still in the womb.
10. Community is individuals, community groups, including parents and families.
11. Prevention is all efforts to eliminate all risks and adverse impacts of violence against women and children.

I 11 - 5 -

12. Child-Friendly City hereinafter abbreviated as KLA is a Community that is conducive to developing all social psychological potential of a person optimally.
13. Child Obligations are everything that must be carried out by children according to the function and role of children.
14. Forum for Handling Victims of Violence Against Women and Children hereinafter abbreviated as FPK2PA is a coordination forum for handling victims of violence against women and children whose implementation is tiered at the city and sub-district levels.
15. Integrated Service Center for Women's Empowerment and Children hereinafter abbreviated as P2TP2A is an integrated service center in efforts to empower women in various fields of development, as well as protection of women and children from various types of discrimination, and acts of violence, including trafficking in persons established by the regional government or community-based.
16. Child-Friendly Village hereinafter abbreviated as KRA is the development of village areas that unites the commitment and resources of the village government involving the community and the business world located in the village in order to promote, protect, fulfill and respect children's rights, which are planned consciously and sustainably.

Article 30

1. The community is involved in the Protection of Women and Child Victims of Violence.
2. Community involvement as referred to in paragraph (1) is in the form of participation through prevention, services, empowerment, monitoring, supervision and fulfillment of the rights of Women and/or Children.

CHAPTER IX

REPORTING

Article 33

1. Reporting as referred to in Article 32 paragraph (5) serves as material for the Mayor's consideration in making policy decisions on the implementation of Protection of Women and Child Victims of Violence.
2. Reports on the implementation of Protection of Women and Child Victims of Violence as referred to in paragraph (1) are carried out 1 (one) time in 1 (one) year or at any time if necessary.

Article 27

1. In order to protect and guarantee the rights of Women and Children from acts of violence, FPK2PA is established.
2. FPK2PA as referred to in paragraph (1) consists of: a. Regional FPK2PA;
b. sub-district FPK2PA; andc. village FPK2PA.
3. The establishment of Regional FPK2PA as referred to in paragraph (2) letter a is determined by the Mayor.

CHAPTER VII

GUIDANCE AND SUPERVISION

Article 31

1. The Mayor is obliged to carry out guidance and supervision of the Protection of Women and Child Victims of Violence.

(2) The implementation of guidance and supervision as referred to in paragraph (1) is carried out by the Regional Apparatus that administers affairs in the field of Women's empowerment and Protection of Child Victims of Violence.

I 11 • 19 - (3) Guidance and supervision as referred to in paragraph (1) includes:
a. coordination;
b. guidance;
c. education and training;
d. monitoring and evaluation; ande. reporting.
4. Guidance and supervision as referred to in paragraph (1) to realize the objectives of Protection of Women and Children in accordance with norms, standards, procedures, and criteria implemented by the Regional Apparatus that administers affairs in the field of Women's empowerment and Child Protection.
5. Guidance and supervision as referred to in paragraph (1) is carried out with professional and transparent principles.
6. In carrying out guidance and supervision as referred to in paragraph (1), the Regional Apparatus that administers affairs in the field of Women's empowerment and Child Protection must report regularly to the Mayor.
7. In the case of guidance and supervision as referred to in paragraph (2), the Regional Apparatus that administers affairs in the field of Women's empowerment and Child Protection may cooperate and coordinate with other Regional Apparatus, the community, other agencies and/or organizational institutions.

a. prevention of marriage at the age of Children;
b. bringing Women closer to health services; andc. strengthening family resilience.

Article 19

1. In order to ensure the effectiveness of the implementation of Protection of Women and Children, the Regional Government must carry out cross-sectoral coordination with related institutions.
2. In organizing the coordination of Protection of Women and Children as referred to in paragraph (1), the Mayor establishes a coordination team for the Protection of Women and Children.

(3) In the coordination forum activities as referred to in paragraph (2), the coordination team for the Protection of Women and Children has the duties of: a. preparing materials needed related to the implementation of Protection of Women and Children; and
b. conveying results, obstacles, and solutions undertaken to overcome obstacles in the implementation of Protection of Women and Children.

III - 14 - (4) The coordination forum as referred to in paragraph (3) is conducted periodically, at least 2 (two) times in 1 (one) year.

Article 23

1. P2TP2A provides services and temporary protection in the form of a safe house.
2. In the event that P2TP2A does not yet have a safe house, victims of violence are referred to other integrated service centers that have safe houses.

Funding for the implementation of Protection of Women and Child Victims of Violence is sourced from:
